headline: As of 2026-10-20: 10,525,889 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 40 of 50 states, D+18.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 10,525,889 early/mail ballots cast so far across 40 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+18.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,414,541), Florida (1,099,898), Georgia (1,024,977).
